verdict.rationale: Segment documents a Public API with token-based authentication, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, rate limits, pagination and versioning. It supports full CRUD on workspace resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans, so headless, scripted management without the UI is clearly possible, and event tracking itself is code-driven via libraries. However, nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, CI-specific tooling, or a documented pipeline workflow, so CI use relies on hand-built API scripting. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Action or IaC provider), documented CI/automation workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
